column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the virtual idol (e.g., 'IDOL001').
A VARCHAR(100) for the idol’s name or stage name.
An enum (IdolType_enum) describing the idol's nature (2D, AI Generated, 3D, Mixed Reality).
A DATE for the idol's debut (e.g., '2023-06-01').
A VARCHAR(100) naming the idol's company or group affiliation.
An enum (IdolGenre_enum) indicating the idol’s main genre (Electronic, Dance, Pop, Traditional, Rock).
A VARCHAR(50) referencing the idol's primary performance language (e.g., 'English').
